payload.rationale: The root cause is the off-by-one loop `for i in range(len(self.items) - 1)` in `Cart.subtotal()`, which visits only indices 0..len-2 and silently drops the last line item from the sum. Iterating directly over `self.items` includes every line item, so the cart with 2 mugs ($25.00) + 1 lamp ($39.99) + 3 pens ($3.00) now sums to $67.99. Empty-cart behavior is unchanged (`for item in []` adds nothing, same as `range(-1)` yielding nothing).
